prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body dual-body portrait: left leg tier L4, right leg tier L0, collarbone boundary. ONE woman standing, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, the camera set back so her whole body fits in the frame from the top of her head to her feet, her face still sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Ethiopian woman in Habesha makeup — smooth warm-brown skin, a bold thick black liner drawn around the whole eye and winged slightly at the outer corner, warm gold and brown eyeshadow, strongly defined softly arched brows, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural warm rose-brown lip with a soft gloss, long black hair in fine neat braids swept back from the face, a serene, dignified expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a large real pearl drop with a gold clip.

Physique: A towering giantess on an even scale at full head-to-toe height — massive rounded shoulders, huge thick arms, a colossal full chest, a broad heavy torso with a large smooth rounded belly, wide solid hips, her entire left leg, foot and glass sandal are part of the vessel above, all the way to the base of each toe; her right leg entirely — thigh, knee, calf, ankle and foot — is part of the vessel above, ending in a glass sandal.

Material body: below the collarbones — her whole chest, both arms, both hands, belly, hips, her entire left leg, foot and glass sandal are part of the vessel above, all the way to the base of each toe, and her right leg entirely — thigh, knee, calf, ankle and foot — is part of the vessel above, ending in a glass sandal — is a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass. The vessel is completely filled with clear ice-blue water from the collarbone line down through whichever leg parts remain part of the vessel, with no hollow space and no air gap anywhere inside it. The glass is unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, with bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights and dark refraction edges where the walls are thickest, tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself. Both arms below the shoulder, both hands, and every finger and knuckle, are the same solid clear glass as the rest of the vessel, with no skin anywhere on them. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through the whole filled volume — passing beside and between both hands and every finger, rising through her whole chest up to the collarbone line itself, winding around both hips, and drifting through whichever thigh and leg sections remain glass, never crowding, always with open water around each one.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Left leg transition: Her left foot, including its toes, is almost entirely made of the same glass vessel and clear water as the rest of that leg, standing in an extreme platform stiletto sandal carved from that same glass. Only the last few millimetres at the very tip of each toe on the left foot are different — no wider than the toenail itself — where the real toenail and the tiny pad of real flesh just behind it are genuinely real, living flesh. Everything else on that foot — the rest of each toe, the whole foot, and the sandal — is entirely glass. This tiny real tip on each toe is a separate thing entirely from the glass around it, sharing nothing with it — an ordinary, undisturbed real toe-tip, never itself cut, never marked. The glass foot and sandal end cleanly and deliberately right at the base of each of these real toe-tips.

Left leg (real): only the tiny real toe-tips on her left foot, natural skin texture. her left foot stands in a matching glass sandal, carved from the same clear material.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a soft periwinkle blue on one side and a warm champagne gold on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle — glowing evenly, marked with a few thin dark vertical lines spaced evenly across it so the bending of those lines inside her material body is unmistakable, and a glossy dark floor beneath her feet.

Pose: standing tall, body angled 45 degrees, feet planted apart, her left hand (solid glass) resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand (solid glass) relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods her material body from behind, so blue light passes through one side and gold light passes through the other, the vertical lines clearly visible bending inside the glass. A soft frontal light falls on her face, ears and any real leg parts. A thin cool rim light traces her whole figure. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
